svg.title: How faces_reciprocal sets the inbound heading of a bay and a charger
svg.desc: Animated: bay 7 and chargers 10 and 14 of the Pecos YAML; GetInboundHeading adds 180 when faces_reciprocal is true and does not wrap; the bay pose, its outbound pose, the retrieval heading cached on parking nodes, the charging poses, and the unwrapped comparison in PlanAgvChargeJob.
svg.metadata: ["Three YAML entries that all list headings [90]. Bay 7 and charger 14 add faces_reciprocal: true; charger 10 has faces_reciprocal: false. The heading list alone says only which axis the node allows (90 and its reciprocal -90); faces_reciprocal picks the direction that counts.", "GetInboundHeading (layout.cpp L34) returns headings[0] + faces_reciprocal x 180: 90 + 180 = 270 for bay 7. It does not wrap. GetBayInboundHeading wraps it: Wrap(270) = -90, the only form a GaragePose can hold (int16 in [-179, 180]).", "The bay pose (7, -90). Heading -90 faces east: AGV-1's body +y, its driving axis, points out of the bay through the garage-side door towards W31. With faces_reciprocal false it would face west, towards the patron side (layout.hpp: true = the listed heading has +y towards the patron door).", "GetBayOutboundPose (pose_graph.cpp L215) builds the same primary pose and returns its LEFT neighbour: (31, -90), 4.902 m east, a LOCOMOTE along body +y. The header promises it is always LEFT; nothing in the snapshots calls it.", "The retrieval heading. bay_prioritization_ is [21, 7] (both values 0, ties to the higher id), so InitRetrievalHeadings takes back() = bay 7, its inbound heading -90 and the reciprocal 90. It caches 90 on every Parking node that allows 90 and can reach (7, 90): all ten, P5 and P15 among them.", "Chargers. C10: faces_reciprocal false, 90 + 0 = 90, AGV-1 charges facing west. C14 (and C16): true, 90 + 180 = 270, stored as pose (14, -90), AGV-2 charges facing east. Both are reached by a 0.61 m strafe: (9, 90) FORWARD -> (10, 90) and (15, -90) FORWARD -> (14, -90).", "The unwrapped comparison. PlanAgvChargeJob (scheduler.cpp L1505) asks whether the AGV is already charging with agv.pose.heading == GetInboundHeading(curr_node). For AGV-1 on C10 that is 90 == 90. For AGV-2 on C14 it is -90 == 270: false, so AGV-2 is not recognised as charging. Read from the code, not observed: the search that follows skips occupied chargers, C14 included, so it plans a move to another free charger or reports none available. The destination pose at L1548 does wrap."]

g.text: Consequence, read from the code and not observed: an AGV already charging on C14 or C16 is treated as not charging; the charger loop

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: then skips every occupied charger (GetAgvOnNode), its own included, and plans a move to the cheapest other free charger, or fails with

g.text: 'No available charge nodes'. Charger 10 is unaffected. A scheduler-only fix: compare with Wrap(GetInboundHeading(curr_node)).

g.text: Code from layout.cpp, pose_graph.cpp and scheduler.cpp (line numbers inside each file of the snapshot). volley::Wrap is not in the snapshots; Wrap(270) = -90 follows the [-179, 180] range of GaragePose.msg and the explicit Wrap the scheduler applies at L1548. Scheduler::ApplyTransitionToFreeingMoves (VECS) also uses the unwrapped value;

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Pecos has no VECS node. Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.
